svg.title: A neuron's gradient carries its input, and deep in a network that input changes every batch
svg.text: Same neuron, deep in a network, training

g.text: Double the input, double the step.
The layer below updates too, so the next batch brings a
different x, and w takes a step of a different size.
Toy: one weight w, L = |y − t|, so the step on w is η·x (η = 0.25). Input sizes are made up.
